behaviors_covered: All eight researched nominal vectors specify every input and assert every output at 1e-6 relative tolerance.
Junction: heat balance, zero feedback, shifted reference, inclusive fit endpoints, gain at/above unity, positive ambient-power requirement, every fit guard and equilibrium outside fit.
Heatsink: series budget identity, zero interface resistance, power scaling, reversed/equal temperature allowance and zero/negative sink headroom.
Conduction: geometry-derived resistances, equal sharing, exchanged paths, energy conservation, zero heat and tiny nonzero heat below temperature-resolution scale.
Lumped response: complete capacitance/resistance/time/Biot outputs, initial condition, unpowered cooling/warming, long-time equilibrium, short-time conditioning, Biot just below and at/above 0.1.
Arrhenius: independent exponent 0.5 and 500 vectors, unity at equal temperatures, zero exposure, inclusive energy/duration maxima, reversed stress, factor overflow and separately exposure overflow.
Derating: plateau, breakpoint, midpoint, zero-power endpoint, zero margin, negative overload margin, inverted curve and above-endpoint rejection.
TCR: signed slopes and cooling, zero slope/delta-temperature, both fit endpoints, every fit guard and zero/negative extrapolated resistance.
Expansion: signed CTE and cooling, zero CTE/delta-temperature, both inclusive 1% strain limits, all fit guards and excessive strain of either sign.
Every scalar positive/nonnegative bound, Arrhenius upper bounds and nonfinite values across every input. Algebraic zeros explicitly require zero absolute tolerance; no blanket near-zero allowance.
verification: Authored and statically reviewed for shared API/syntax consistency only. No builds, tests, linters, formatters or smoke commands executed.
untested_gaps: Parent must execute the authored integration target and complete suite.
Real JSON-lines process and native desktop behavior remain parent-owned and unexecuted by this worker.
No exhaustive floating-point extreme sweep or physical hardware validation; documented qualitative applicability assumptions cannot be inferred from scalar inputs.
parent_checks: Run full integrated Rust suite after all tester commits land.
parent_error_recovery_scenario: Send the junction scenario with power_coefficient changed to 0.05 (gain=1), require ok=false, then send the original valid scenario on the same process and require all three outputs above.
parent_desktop_scenarios: Select each of the eight thermal IDs, apply its complete researched example, and compare every displayed output and unit with docs/features/thermal.md.
Display derating overload scenario: negative -0.5 W margin must remain a successful result, not an error or zero clamp.
Display negative TCR and negative expansion scenarios; signed changes and positive final resistance/length must remain visible.
For junction, calculate valid shifted-reference vector, then set coefficient to 0.05: editing must invalidate prior outputs and calculation must show an error; restore 0.01 and recover.
For lumped model, use zero power and initially hotter body: body temperature must decrease toward ambient; elapsed_time=0 must recover the entered initial temperature.
